en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Acquisition of fundamental knowledge of inorganic and organic nomenclature and nomenclature of natural components. Practising on particular examples. Chemical calculation.

Aromatic hydrocarbons.b.Hydroxy derivatives: alcohols and phenols.c.Ethers.d.Carbonyl compounds: aldehydes, ketones, hemiacetales.e.Carboxylic acids: mono-, di- and tricarboxylic acids and their salts.f.Functional derivatives: amides, esters.g.Substitution derivatives: hydroxy acids, oxo acids, amino acids.6.Natural components nomenclature (allowance 0/6) a.Saccharides: monosacharides, oligosacharides, polysaccharides.b.Peptides.c.Lipids: simple and compound.d.Terpenes.e.Phenolic plant components.
